hook: Your feet walk through warm blue pools on white stone.
title: Your Feet On White Stone Pools In Turkey
description:
Pamukkale in Turkey is famous for white terraces filled with warm blue water. They are made of travertine, a stone left behind by mineral-rich spring water over a very long time. The name means cotton castle in Turkish.

#Shorts #Pamukkale #PlacesThatShouldntExist
